prompt.en: How long a heritage do the million Anglo-Quebecers have in Quebec?
prompt.fr: De quelle ancienneté est le patrimoine du million d'Anglo-Québécois au Québec?

explanation.en: A million Anglo-Quebecers have a heritage of 250 years and form a lively part of the fabric of Quebec. Quebec has never been only French-speaking.
explanation.fr: Un million d'Anglo-Québécois possèdent un patrimoine de 250 ans et forment une partie dynamique du tissu québécois. Le Québec n'a jamais été uniquement francophone.

source.quote: One million Anglo-Quebecers have a heritage of 250 years and form a vibrant part of the Quebec fabric.

verification.evidence: have a heritage of 250 years and form a vibrant part of the Quebec fabric
